A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AOSD is a systemic inflammatory disease that may involve the immune system and the endocrine system.
NK cells are involved in the pathogenesis of AOSD, and that the NK cell proportion and function are improved after treatment.
NK cell cytotoxic dysfunction is a characteristic feature of AOSD and that the dysfunction may be associated with the elevated IL-18 and the low NK cell proportion.

NK cells may be a potential therapeutic target in AOSD.
NK cell dysfunction and elevated IL- 18 levels may be important features of AOS.
